added_failures_note: Derived with reckon.crew.review.added_failures_from_gate_logs over the reviewed run's own arms: logs/suite-base.log (revision 4992939f84cb, 58 passed, EXIT=0) and logs/suite-after.log (revision f30c8b62d8, 63 passed, EXIT=0); both parse as pytest logs with no FAILED or ERROR id, so the count is a measured 0 rather than an unmeasured one. The base log's own '# command:' line names no test path and its progress line is NUL-padded, so the base arm's scope is taken from manifest.md rather than from the log.

findings.text: The negative-control paragraph says the mutated tree 'fails 3 of 5 cases', but the log it cites (logs/negative-control-restore-whole-stream-scans.log, 'FF.FF', '4 failed, 1 passed', EXIT=1) reports four failures, so the fragment understates the coverage its own control demonstrated.

The arms paragraph records '63 passed at head 825335b101', but the after-arm log the manifest cites for that figure (logs/suite-after.log:1) carries revision f30c8b62d8, so the fragment names a revision its own receipt does not carry and a reader cannot line the two up.

The base arm's '# command:' line ends at a bare '-q ' with no test path while manifest.md records two test files for it, and line 6 is a NUL-padded progress line carrying F markers over a '58 passed' summary, so the base receipt is not one clean invocation a reader can reconstruct and the pair's scope is taken on the manifest's word.

The quiet-tick zero has no positive half: the decodes are reset before each tick at :302 and nothing asserts the first _tick decoded a document, so a tick that stopped reading pointers and verdicts entirely, or a decode that moved into a module outside the counted set, leaves this assertion green where the stream case does assert its positive half at :163.

_stream_scan reuses a record on inode equality plus st_size >= covered, which is the same-file/not-truncated test reckon/crew/follow_checkpoint.py:123 continues owns, re-expressed instead of called; it also drops the head-fingerprint guard the repository's other incremental reader uses (reckon/crew/recovery_stream.py:540 through _backends.stream_head_fingerprint), so a stream rewritten in place without shrinking keeps the predecessor's assistant-seen flag and last record type.

item_verdicts.diff: Read the five commits against 4992939f84cb one at a time: 60dab4e501 adds _StreamScan and the three offset readers, 15c2018bc8 adds StationStore._decoded_document/_remember_decoded and pointer_fields, 825335b101 and e6fabd7700 add the failure figure and the evidence fragment, f30c8b62d8 falls the pointer_fields key back to the run id for rows a caller built itself.
item_verdicts.done_when: Read the done_when clause by clause against tests/test_a_classification_reads_only_new_stream_lines.py: 30 runs of 2,000 lines classified twice with a zero second pass at :163/:168, one appended line decoded and the verdict flipped at :191/:196, truncation rescanned at :213, an unterminated record held at its last newline at :235/:247, the codex ingest columns and quiet tick at :294/:305, and the 60,000-decode control at logs/negative-control-restore-whole-stream-scans.log:244251; the manifest's gate is that file, which I re-ran at the head (5 passed, EXIT=0).
item_verdicts.goal: Read the goal in dispatch-detail.json (node.goal: 'Classify each run by reading only the stream lines appended since its last scan') against the head; reckon/crew/recovery_wait.py:1644 answers the assistant-record question from a stored byte offset, :241 and :1571 the two tail questions, so every stream read a later pass makes is over appended bytes.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read manifest.md: status complete over the five commits 60dab4e501..f30c8b62d8, the gate at 5 passed EXIT=0, both suite arms at 0 failures, the negative control at 60000 decodes with 4 failed, the matched 69-file importer arms at 13 failed with 389 vs 394 passed and an empty added set, and one entry under outside_scope.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read the dispatch fence at prompt.txt:85-90 (recovery_wait.py, station.py, station_store.py, the new test file, the evidence fragment, one figure directory) against `git diff --name-only 4992939f84cb f30c8b62d8`, which lists five files, every one inside that declaration.

justifications.durability: Restoring the whole-stream scan reddens tests/test_a_classification_reads_only_new_stream_lines.py:168 with 60000 decodes (logs/negative-control-restore-whole-stream-scans.log:29-32) and reinstating json.loads at reckon/crew/station_store.py:483 reddens :305, but nothing asserts the first _tick decodes a document so :305 also stays green on a tick that stopped reading the store, and the in-place rewrite has no test.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_classification_reads_only_new_stream_lines.py:163 asserts the first pass clears RUNS*LINES before the zero is reported and logs/gate-head.log records 5 passed EXIT=0 at f30c8b62 which I reproduced, but logs/suite-base.log:3 names no test path and its progress line at :6 is NUL-padded with F markers over a '58 passed' summary, so the base arm's scope rests on the manifest.
justifications.fit: The helpers follow the module's docstringed private-function idiom (reckon/crew/recovery_wait.py:157), but the process-global _STREAM_SCANS at reckon/crew/recovery_wait.py:127 is module-level mutable state where the repository's other incremental reader threads a caller-owned memo (reckon/crew/recovery_stream.py:540).
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_wait.py:1644 and :241 both resume from a stored offset and rescan only when the inode moved or the file shrank, so classifying a long-lived run no longer decodes its whole stream, which is the goal stated.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/recovery_wait.py:131's continuation test is reckon/crew/follow_checkpoint.py:123 continues' same-file/not-truncated predicate re-expressed without calling that owner, while _decoded_document at reckon/crew/station_store.py:473 has no owner (a search over reckon/crew for a text-keyed decode cache found only admission/readiness.py:334, which serves a different capability).
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in `git diff --name-only 4992939f84cb f30c8b62d8` is one of those declared at prompt.txt:85-90, and the sixth declared path (the figure directory) is left untouched rather than filled.
